#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Usage: dmmock.py SCENARIO -- PROGRAM [ARG...]
Answers the device-mapper ioctls LIST_DEVICES (cmd 2), TABLE_STATUS (12) and LIST_VERSIONS (13) of PROGRAM with a crafted reply
written through /proc/PID/mem; the unused tail of the caller's buffer is filled with the marker SENTINELSENTINEL... so that any read
past the declared data_size shows up in the output. Every other call continues."""
import ctypes, errno, fcntl, os, select, struct, sys, time
ALLOW, NOTIFY = 0x7fff0000, 0x7fc00000
RECV, SEND = 0xc0502100, 0xc0182101
scenario = sys.argv[1]
program = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
HDR = 312
def pad8(n): return (n + 7) & ~7
def name_list(entries):
    """entries: list of (name_bytes, next_override|None, terminate)"""
    out = b""
    for k, (name, nxt, term) in enumerate(entries):
        body = struct.pack("<Q", 0x1000 + k)
        raw = name + (b"\0" if term else b"")
        size = pad8(12 + len(raw))
        last = k == len(entries) - 1
        nx = nxt if nxt is not None else (0 if last else size)
        rec = body + struct.pack("<I", nx) + raw
        out += rec.ljust(size, b"\0") if term else rec
    return out
def versions(entries):
    out = b""
    for k, (name, nxt, term) in enumerate(entries):
        raw = name + (b"\0" if term else b"")
        size = pad8(16 + len(raw))
        last = k == len(entries) - 1
        nx = nxt if nxt is not None else (0 if last else size)
        rec = struct.pack("<IIII", nx, 1, 2, 3) + raw
        out += rec.ljust(size, b"\0") if term else rec
    return out
def specs(entries):
    """entries: (type_bytes16, params_bytes, next_override|None, terminate_params)"""
    out = b""
    for k, (typ, params, nxt, term) in enumerate(entries):
        raw = params + (b"\0" if term else b"")
        size = pad8(40 + len(raw))
        last = k == len(entries) - 1
        nx = nxt if nxt is not None else size
        rec = struct.pack("<QQiI", k * 8, 8, 0, nx) + typ.ljust(16, b"\0")[:16] + raw
        out += rec.ljust(size, b"\0") if term else rec
    return out
BIG = 0x7fff0000
S = {
 "ls-good": (2, name_list([(b"good1", None, True), (b"good2", None, True)]), 2),
 "ls-next-beyond-buffer": (2, name_list([(b"good1", BIG, True)]), 1),
 "ls-next-into-unused-tail": (2, name_list([(b"good1", 400, True)]), 1),
 "ls-name-unterminated": (2, name_list([(b"unterminated-name", None, False)]), 1),
 "ls-next-backwards": (2, name_list([(b"good1", 0xfffffff0, True)]), 1),
 "ls-next-zero-length-loop": (2, name_list([(b"good1", 4, True)]), 1),
 "targets-good": (13, versions([(b"linear", None, True), (b"zero", None, True)]), 2),
 "targets-next-beyond-buffer": (13, versions([(b"linear", BIG, True)]), 1),
 "targets-next-into-unused-tail": (13, versions([(b"linear", 400, True)]), 1),
 "targets-name-unterminated": (13, versions([(b"unterminated-target", None, False)]), 1),
 "targets-next-backwards": (13, versions([(b"linear", 0xfffffff0, True)]), 1),
 "table-good": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null 0", None, True), (b"zero", b"", None, True)]), 2),
 "table-next-beyond-buffer": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null 0", BIG, True)]), 2),
 "table-next-into-unused-tail": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null 0", 400, True)]), 2),
 "table-params-unterminated": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null-unterminated-parameters", None, False)]), 1),
 "table-type-unterminated": (12, specs([(b"X" * 16, b"p", None, True)]), 1),
 "table-count-exceeds-records": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null 0", None, True)]), 50),
}
cmd, payload, count = S[scenario]
want = 0xc138fd00 | cmd
lib = ctypes.CDLL("libseccomp.so.2", use_errno=True)
class ArgCmp(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("arg", ctypes.c_uint), ("op", ctypes.c_int), ("datum_a", ctypes.c_uint64), ("datum_b", ctypes.c_uint64)]
lib.seccomp_init.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
lib.seccomp_init.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint32]
lib.seccomp_rule_add_array.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.POINTER(ArgCmp)]
lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_name.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p]
lib.seccomp_load.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
lib.seccomp_notify_fd.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_num_arch.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_num_arch.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_int]
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
pid_ = os.fork()
if pid_ == 0:
    try:
        ctx = lib.seccomp_init(ALLOW)
        none = (ArgCmp * 1)()
        eq = (ArgCmp * 1)(ArgCmp(1, 4, want, 0))
        lib.seccomp_rule_add_array(ctx, NOTIFY, lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_name(b"ioctl"), 1, eq)
        if lib.seccomp_load(ctx) != 0:
            raise RuntimeError("load")
        listener = lib.seccomp_notify_fd(ctx)
        os.set_inheritable(listener, True)
        os.execv(program[0], program)
    except BaseException as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("closeinj: %s\n" % exc)
    os._exit(126)
child = pid_
pidfd = os.pidfd_open(child)
libc.syscall.restype = ctypes.c_long
listener = None
deadline = time.time() + 15
while listener is None and time.time() < deadline:
    try:
        for entry in os.listdir("/proc/%d/fd" % child):
            try:
                link = os.readlink("/proc/%d/fd/%s" % (child, entry))
            except OSError:
                continue
            if "seccomp" in link:
                got = libc.syscall(438, pidfd, int(entry), 0)
                if got >= 0:
                    listener = got; break
    except OSError:
        pass
    if listener is None:
        time.sleep(0.001)
if listener is None:
    os.kill(child, 9); sys.exit("closeinj: no listener")
names = {}
def sysname(nr):
    if nr not in names:
        names[nr] = ctypes.cast(lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_num_arch(0, nr), ctypes.c_char_p).value.decode()
    return names[nr]
log = None
status = None
while status is None:
    done, wait = os.waitpid(child, os.WNOHANG)
    if done:
        status = wait; break
    ready, _, _ = select.select([listener], [], [], 0.05)
    if not ready:
        continue
    req = bytearray(80)
    try:
        fcntl.ioctl(listener, RECV, req, True)
    except OSError as exc:
        if exc.errno in (errno.ENOENT, errno.EINTR):
            continue
        raise
    ident, pid, _f, nr, _a, _ip = struct.unpack_from("<QIIiIQ", req)
    args = struct.unpack_from("<6Q", req, 32)
    resp = struct.pack("<QqiI", ident, 0, 0, 1)
    try:
        fd = os.open("/proc/%d/mem" % pid, os.O_RDWR)
        hdr = bytearray(os.pread(fd, HDR, args[2]))
        size = struct.unpack_from("<I", hdr, 12)[0]
        declared = HDR + len(payload)
        struct.pack_into("<IIII", hdr, 12, declared, HDR, count, 0)
        struct.pack_into("<I", hdr, 28, 0)
        tail = (b"SENTINEL" * (size // 8 + 2))[: max(0, size - declared)]
        os.pwrite(fd, bytes(hdr) + payload + tail, args[2])
        os.close(fd)
        resp = struct.pack("<QqiI", ident, 0, 0, 0)
    except OSError:
        resp = struct.pack("<QqiI", ident, 0, -errno.EFAULT, 0)
    try:
        fcntl.ioctl(listener, SEND, resp)
    except OSError as exc:
        if exc.errno != errno.ENOENT:
            raise
sys.exit(os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status) if os.WIFEXITED(status) else 128 + os.WTERMSIG(status))

 "ls-next-beyond-buffer": (2, name_list([(b"good1", BIG, True)]), 1),
 "ls-next-into-unused-tail": (2, name_list([(b"good1", 400, True)]), 1),
 "ls-name-unterminated": (2, name_list([(b"unterminated-name", None, False)]), 1),
 "ls-next-backwards": (2, name_list([(b"good1", 0xfffffff0, True)]), 1),
 "ls-next-zero-length-loop": (2, name_list([(b"good1", 4, True)]), 1),
 "targets-good": (13, versions([(b"linear", None, True), (b"zero", None, True)]), 2),
 "targets-next-beyond-buffer": (13, versions([(b"linear", BIG, True)]), 1),
 "targets-next-into-unused-tail": (13, versions([(b"linear", 400, True)]), 1),
 "targets-name-unterminated": (13, versions([(b"unterminated-target", None, False)]), 1),
 "targets-next-backwards": (13, versions([(b"linear", 0xfffffff0, True)]), 1),
 "table-good": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null 0", None, True), (b"zero", b"", None, True)]), 2),
 "table-next-beyond-buffer": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null 0", BIG, True)]), 2),
 "table-next-into-unused-tail": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null 0", 400, True)]), 2),
 "table-params-unterminated": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null-unterminated-parameters", None, False)]), 1),
 "table-type-unterminated": (12, specs([(b"X" * 16, b"p", None, True)]), 1),
 "table-count-exceeds-records": (12, specs([(b"linear", b"/dev/null 0", None, True)]), 50),
}
cmd, payload, count = S[scenario]
want = 0xc138fd00 | cmd
lib = ctypes.CDLL("libseccomp.so.2", use_errno=True)
class ArgCmp(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("arg", ctypes.c_uint), ("op", ctypes.c_int), ("datum_a", ctypes.c_uint64), ("datum_b", ctypes.c_uint64)]
lib.seccomp_init.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
lib.seccomp_init.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint32]
lib.seccomp_rule_add_array.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.POINTER(ArgCmp)]
lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_name.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p]
lib.seccomp_load.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
lib.seccomp_notify_fd.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_num_arch.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_num_arch.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_int]
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
pid_ = os.fork()
if pid_ == 0:
    try:
        ctx = lib.seccomp_init(ALLOW)
        none = (ArgCmp * 1)()
        eq = (ArgCmp * 1)(ArgCmp(1, 4, want, 0))
        lib.seccomp_rule_add_array(ctx, NOTIFY, lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_name(b"ioctl"), 1, eq)
        if lib.seccomp_load(ctx) != 0:
            raise RuntimeError("load")
        listener = lib.seccomp_notify_fd(ctx)
        os.set_inheritable(listener, True)
        os.execv(program[0], program)
    except BaseException as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("closeinj: %s\n" % exc)
    os._exit(126)
child = pid_
pidfd = os.pidfd_open(child)
libc.syscall.restype = ctypes.c_long
listener = None
deadline = time.time() + 15
while listener is None and time.time() < deadline:
    try:
        for entry in os.listdir("/proc/%d/fd" % child):
            try:
                link = os.readlink("/proc/%d/fd/%s" % (child, entry))
            except OSError:
                continue
            if "seccomp" in link:
                got = libc.syscall(438, pidfd, int(entry), 0)
                if got >= 0:
                    listener = got; break
    except OSError:
        pass
    if listener is None:
        time.sleep(0.001)
if listener is None:
    os.kill(child, 9); sys.exit("closeinj: no listener")
names = {}
def sysname(nr):
    if nr not in names:
        names[nr] = ctypes.cast(lib.seccomp_syscall_resolve_num_arch(0, nr), ctypes.c_char_p).value.decode()
    return names[nr]
log = None
status = None
while status is None:
    done, wait = os.waitpid(child, os.WNOHANG)
    if done:
        status = wait; break
    ready, _, _ = select.select([listener], [], [], 0.05)
    if not ready:
        continue
    req = bytearray(80)
    try:
        fcntl.ioctl(listener, RECV, req, True)
    except OSError as exc:
        if exc.errno in (errno.ENOENT, errno.EINTR):
            continue
        raise
    ident, pid, _f, nr, _a, _ip = struct.unpack_from("<QIIiIQ", req)
    args = struct.unpack_from("<6Q", req, 32)
    resp = struct.pack("<QqiI", ident, 0, 0, 1)
    try:
        fd = os.open("/proc/%d/mem" % pid, os.O_RDWR)
        hdr = bytearray(os.pread(fd, HDR, args[2]))
        size = struct.unpack_from("<I", hdr, 12)[0]
        declared = HDR + len(payload)
        struct.pack_into("<IIII", hdr, 12, declared, HDR, count, 0)
        struct.pack_into("<I", hdr, 28, 0)
        tail = (b"SENTINEL" * (size // 8 + 2))[: max(0, size - declared)]
        os.pwrite(fd, bytes(hdr) + payload + tail, args[2])
        os.close(fd)
        resp = struct.pack("<QqiI", ident, 0, 0, 0)
    except OSError:
        resp = struct.pack("<QqiI", ident, 0, -errno.EFAULT, 0)
    try:
        fcntl.ioctl(listener, SEND, resp)
    except OSError as exc:
        if exc.errno != errno.ENOENT:
            raise
sys.exit(os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status) if os.WIFEXITED(status) else 128 + os.WTERMSIG(status))
